## ACCEPT — objectui#8423 / PR objectui#8605, `domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat, 2026-09-08T16:05Z

Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the report's narrative.

### What this seat re-measured

| claim | this seat's reading | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the main-line factory case lacked all three lines | `git show origin/main:…test.ts` `:1491-1505` ⇒ exactly four expects (`factoryTables > 25`, `factoryComparedRows > 500`, `factoryUnreadableTables` `.toBe(0)`, `factoryUnreadableRows` `.toBe(0)`) and nothing else | ✅ |
| ⭐ **the trap was avoided** | the `.toBe(1)` hits sit inside `it('leaves a key en does not define to class 1…')` and `it('counts rather than judges a plural family…')` — **synthetic fixtures**, ⛔ not the main-line case. Control: the symbol occurs twice in the file, so the read saw the file | ✅ |
| ⛔ no bound weakened | the PR's `deletions` count is **0**. Nothing was removed anywhere, so the two lower bounds are byte-identical by arithmetic, ⛔ not by assertion | ✅ |
| ⛔ the gate script is untouched | changed files = `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts` (+17) and `.changeset/8423-i18n-factory-abstention-pins.md` (+12). `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` is **not** in the diff | ✅ |
| the three lines are the hand-rolled mirror | patch adds `factoryRowsNoEnKey` `.toBe(0)`, `factoryUnjudgedRows` `.toBe(0)`, `factoryMatchingRows` `.toBe(counters.factoryComparedRows)` | ✅ |
| draft, `Fixes #8423` in the body | `draft: true`, body carries it | ✅ |

⭐ **The counters read clean, so the stop-and-report branch was correctly not entered** — `factoryRowsNoEnKey` 0, `factoryUnjudgedRows` 0, `factoryMatchingRows` 846 = `factoryComparedRows` 846, alongside 32 tables in the same run. ⇒ the zeros clear the two retained lower bounds, which is the whole reason they were ordered kept.

### ⛔ What this seat did NOT re-run, stated rather than implied

The four ablation legs — including the decisive fourth, in which the same mutation against the **pre-change** file left all 137 tests green — are the dev's readings. This seat verified the diff, the preconditions and the tree; it did ⛔ **not** re-execute the ablations, and does not present them as its own measurement. The claim they carry (that `factoryMatchingRows === factoryComparedRows` catches a class `factoryDriftOf(repoRoot).toEqual([])` does not) is recorded as the dev's, with its method stated on the card.

### ⭐ The brief was wrong and the dev was right — changeset level

The dispatch note asked for a **"patch level"** changeset. ⛔ That instruction was incorrect. `AGENTS.md` §9, verbatim:

> **纯内部改动/只动测试就写空 frontmatter(`---` 紧跟 `---`)显式声明「不发版」,那是合法的一等通过写法。要的是「声明一次」,不是强制发版。**

⇒ a test-only change declares an empty frontmatter; `check-changeset-presence.mjs` additionally reports **no changeset is owed at all** for this range. The dev wrote the empty form, released no package, and **flagged the divergence instead of silently following the brief**. ⭐ That is exactly the right handling of a brief that contradicts `AGENTS.md`, and the correction belongs to this seat, ⛔ not to the dev. Publishing it here so the brief's error does not propagate into the next dispatch.

### Deviation noted, ⛔ not reworked

The commit message carries `Fixes #8423` in addition to the PR body. The rule is that the card relation is declared once, in the body. Self-flagged by the dev; the commit is pushed and ⛔ a pushed commit is never amended; both spellings point the same way so a squash cannot contradict itself. Recorded, ⛔ not a rework.

⭐ The commit's attribution trailer carries **no model identifier**, which is the stricter of the two rules in play. Correct call.

### Observed and deliberately not actioned

The case's header comment still reads *"The measurement this class shipped on: 32 … 846 rows, **841 comparable**, 0 drifted"* while today's reading is 846 compared / 846 matching. ⛔ Not a defect: the sentence is explicitly past tense about what the class shipped on. ⭐ And it is now the *only* number in that block carried by a comment alone — which is precisely why the three live counts beside it are pinned as of this PR.

### Next

CI is green-in-progress (20 success, 3 skipped, 9 running, ⛔ 0 failures) on `d04bd60c`. This seat waits for the required set, flips ready, re-reads the post-flip guard, arms SQUASH, confirms the enqueue from the timeline event, and probes the landing on a re-fetched `origin/main` with a firing control and a nonsense control before posting LANDED.

## LANDED — objectui#8423 via PR objectui#8605, merged `7bf133d58`

`merged_at 2026-09-08T16:26:56Z`. ⭐ `removed_from_merge_queue@16:26:55Z` and `merged@16:26:56Z` are one second apart with `merged: true` — ⇒ that removal **is** the merge, ⛔ not a dequeue.

### Landing probe on a re-fetched `origin/main` (tip `7bf133d58`)

⭐ Run as the Armed note scoped it **before** the merge, so ⛔ it could not be shaped afterwards to fit what was found. Attribution is by **enclosing `it()`** — a brace-depth walk over the file — ⛔ never by symbol grep, because that is the exact reading error this card exists to stop.

Every `expect(counters.factory*)` in the file, attributed:

```
:1498  factoryTables).toBeGreaterThan(25)                 <= main carries no factory drift…   FIRING CONTROL
:1499  factoryComparedRows).toBeGreaterThan(500)          <= main carries no factory drift…   FIRING CONTROL
:1519  factoryRowsNoEnKey).toBe(0)                        <= main carries no factory drift…   ⭐ THE PIN
:1520  factoryUnjudgedRows).toBe(0)                       <= main carries no factory drift…   ⭐ THE PIN
:1521  factoryMatchingRows).toBe(counters.factoryCompared <= main carries no factory drift…   ⭐ THE PIN
—
:1422  factoryRowsNoEnKey).toBe(1)                        <= 'leaves a key en does not define to class 1…'   SYNTHETIC
:1433  factoryUnjudgedRows).toBe(1)                       <= 'counts rather than judges a plural family…'    SYNTHETIC
```

| check | reading |
|:--|:--|
| all three pins inside the **main-line** case | ✅ `:1519-1521` |
| the two lower bounds survived | ✅ `:1498`, `:1499`, same case — so the zeros are readings, ⛔ not "the scan found nothing" |
| ⭐ the instrument distinguishes synthetic from main-line | ✅ `:1422` / `:1433` attributed to their own fixture cases — the discrimination the card turns on, demonstrated on the landed tree |
| the file was actually parsed | ✅ 16 factory-counter expects found (⛔ a bare zero would have proved nothing) |
| nonsense control | ✅ exits 1 |

### What is now true that was not

`factoryRowsNoEnKey` went **5 → 0** when objectui#7887 retired the `timeline.relative.*` rows and **nothing in this repository failed**, because the only carriers of that number were comments. ⇒ From `7bf133d58`, the factory half's abstentions and its matching/compared equality **fail loudly when they move**, on the half whose population comes from the SOURCE and therefore moves without anybody choosing to move it.

⭐ The measured cost is the intended one: a change in the blind-spot size now has to be made **deliberately, in a test**, instead of quietly falsifying a comment.
